intro.title: Assignment attempt
intro.description: Start or resume the official attempt linked to your account. The system uses the teacher snapshot and a server-controlled deadline.
intro.ruleOneAttempt: This assignment has one official attempt. Reopening continues that same attempt.
intro.ruleDeadline: The deadline is controlled by the server and keeps running if you close the browser.
intro.ruleDraft: Answers are autosaved while you work.

dialogue.notStarted: Ready? Stay focused and do your best!
dialogue.inProgress: You have an unfinished attempt — continue to finish it.
dialogue.submitted: Great job! This assignment is already submitted.
dialogue.timedOut: This assignment attempt has timed out.

intro.overdueDescription: Your submission will be marked late after the due time.

rules.title: Rules
rules.oneAttempt: Each assignment can be taken once. Progress and results are recorded.
rules.autoSave: Answers are saved automatically when you change them.
rules.noHints: This is an official graded attempt; hints are not available while working.
rules.stayOnScreen: Leaving the page or switching away may be recorded.
rules.singleTab: Do not open the attempt in multiple tabs. Only one active session is allowed.
rules.warning: If you leave the attempt screen, the system may show a warning.

session.conflict: This attempt is open in another tab

submit.title: Submit attempt?
submit.error: Could not submit. Please try again.
submit.sessionMissing: Session not found. Reload the page and try again.

result.title: Attempt result
result.timedOutTitle: Time is up — the system submitted your attempt
result.timedOutHint: Only answers saved on the server before the deadline were graded.
result.scoreHidden: Your score is not available yet.
result.lockedHint: This attempt is locked. You cannot change answers.

draft.warningTitle: Your answers are not saved yet
draft.warningDescription: Do not refresh or close this page if you need to keep these edits.
draft.confirmLeave: Leave this page? Unsaved changes may be lost.

states.alreadySubmitted: This assignment attempt is already finished

errors.invalidAssignment: The assignment ID in this link is invalid.
errors.studentOnly: Only a signed-in student can open this assignment attempt.
errors.startFailedTitle: The attempt could not be opened
errors.startFailedDescription: The server endpoint may not be ready yet. No practice attempt has been mocked locally.
errors.introLoadFailed: Assignment details could not be loaded.

paper.unsupportedType: This question type is not supported by the current Student Paper renderer yet.
paper.matchingPoolMissing: The shared answer pool for this question could not be found.
